decision: Do not port the old PhaseStats class. Derive run_stats from recipe execution reports and plugin diagnostics in the active recipe-pack runner.

classification_rules.created: changed non-delete report whose destination did not exist before execution
classification_rules.pre_existing: non-delete report whose destination existed before execution
classification_rules.identical: pre-existing non-delete report whose final content is unchanged
classification_rules.changed: pre-existing non-delete report whose final content changed
classification_rules.plugin_file_changes: plugin_file_change diagnostics appended by apply-time plugin lifecycle hooks

report_contract.plan: includes run_stats derived from recipe reports with plugin_file_changes equal to 0
report_contract.apply: includes run_stats derived from recipe reports and any plugin file-change diagnostics
report_contract.summary: ASCII one-line summary suitable for CLI/report rendering

verification.command: mise exec -C ruby -- bundle exec rspec gems/kettle-jem/spec/thin_slice_spec.rb
